project.title: Importing Data Using Transform Maps (Spreadsheet)
project.overview: Import employee records from an Excel spreadsheet into a custom ServiceNow table. Data first lands in an Import Set (staging) table, is mapped by a Transform Map, and Coalesce prevents duplicate records.

task.name: Creation of Spreadsheet
task.step: Create an Excel file named employee_data.xlsx.
Add the header row: Employee ID, Name, Email, Department, Location.
Enter 8-10 sample rows; keep Employee ID unique.
Save the file in .xlsx format.

task.name: Creation of Tables
task.step: Open ServiceNow Studio / System Definition > Tables > New.
Label: Employee Details, Name: u_employee_details.
Add the columns listed below and submit.

milestone.name: Creation of Import Set Table and Transform Map

task.name: Create Import Set Table (Staging)
task.description: The Import Set Table is a temporary staging table for data uploaded from the spreadsheet. Records are stored here before transformation.
task.step: Go to System Import Sets > Load Data.
Create table: Label "Employee Import", Name u_employee_import.
Source of data: File, Format: Excel (.xlsx), choose employee_data.xlsx.
Click Submit to load data into the staging table.

task.name: Create Transform Map
task.step: On the loaded Import Set, click Create Transform Map.
Name: Employee Import to Employee Details.
Source table: u_employee_import. Target table: u_employee_details.
Use Auto Map Matching Fields or map each field manually.

milestone.name: Transform Data, Validate and Enable Coalesce to Avoid Duplicate Records

task.name: Transform Data
task.step: Open the Transform Map and click Transform.
Select the Import Set and run the transform.
Check the Transform History for inserted/updated/ignored counts.

task.name: Enable Coalesce
task.step: Open the Field Map for Employee ID.
Tick the Coalesce checkbox and save.
Re-import the same file: existing records are updated, not duplicated.

task.name: Validate
task.step: Open u_employee_details.list and confirm all rows are present.
Verify no duplicate Employee IDs exist after a second import.
Confirm field values match the spreadsheet.

project.expectedOutcome: Spreadsheet data is imported through an Import Set table and transformed into the Employee Details table, with duplicates avoided through Coalesce.
